scene.ofreeRecent: an open field at the edge of a bamboo grove — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; A private covered gallery with latticework looking onto a dock — She sits to enjoy the orange candies she made as a gift; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — carries her keepsake low at her side; An open-sided boat landing where a small ferry waits under the long roof — Lu Ji takes a break from her journey and shares the citrus she brought; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — types a message on a smartphone with both thumbs; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated sideways on a stool or bench; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lying on her front; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — holds a wedge of watermelon out toward the camera; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — lying on her left side; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a neon-lit game arcade — seated on a chair; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — standing; a hilltop lookout over a wide valley — carries her keepsake low at her side
